BrochureContent.Content:
Hegarty Properties are delighted to present No. 24 Shandon Court, Richmond Hill, Cork City — a two-bedroom end-of-terrace residence enjoying an elevated position with superb views across the city skyline, including Shandon, the North Cathedral and many of Cork’s most recognisable landmarks.
Set within a mature and highly convenient residential location, the property is within easy reach of Cork city centre, with its excellent shopping, cafés, restaurants, cultural amenities and business district. McCurtain Street, Oliver Plunkett Street, UCC, St. Angela’s College, Christian Brothers College and a wide range of local services are all easily accessible.
Extending to approx. 54.12 sq. m. / 582.5 sq. ft., the accommodation comprises entrance foyer, open-plan kitchen/dining/living area, two bedrooms and bathroom. While the property would benefit from upgrading, it offers an excellent opportunity for purchasers seeking a city home, investment property or renovation project in a superbly connected Cork City location.

Accommodation: Entrance, Kitchen/dining/living, 2 Bedrooms & Bathroom.  54.12 m2 (Circa 582.5 sq. ft.)

First Floor
Entrance: 	Hallway with lino flooring.

Kitchen/Living/
Dining Room: Fitted kitchen with free standing electric cooker, and fridge/freezer. Bright, dual aspect room with lino flooring and open fireplace with fitted multi-fuel stove. 

Bedroom 1:	Front aspect room with carpet flooring

Ground Floor	
Bedroom 2: This room has good space and overlooks the rear garden of the property. Carpet flooring and built-in wardrobes. 

Bathroom: W.C., wash hand basin, bath and mirrored storage unit. Linoleum flooring.

Outside: 
Private enclosed garden to the rear which is not overlooked. To the front is pedestrian access and benefits from a low-maintenance front terrace area. Its elevated hillside position offers impressive views over Cork City. 

•	Superb location
•	Open fireplace with fitted stove. 
•	On street parking permit available. 
•	Gas fired central heating. 
•	Sewage: Mains and mains water.
•	Large rear garden.
•	Built in approx. 1984. Freehold.
•	Elevated position 
•	Walking distance to Cork City Centre
•	Mature and established residential location
•	Convenient access to schools, colleges, shops, cafés, and public transport
